name: kneeling thoracic rotation
description: A kneeling rotation that opens up the mid back. Good for loosening your upper spine before training or after sitting.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your upper body and point that elbow toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes and keep your hips square.
Return and touch the elbow toward the opposite arm.
Do your reps, then switch sides.
